# Transcriptomics

Preserve the requested method, contrast, identifiers, enrichment source, and
statistical population. These are parts of the estimand, not interchangeable
output formats.

- Match count-matrix sample IDs to metadata before fitting. Confirm the design
  formula, covariates, reference and target levels, and contrast direction.
- Use raw counts for count-model methods unless the named method specifies a
  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.
- Use the matched experimental control. Do not replace a vehicle, batch-matched,
  or paired control with another baseline unless the task defines that contrast.

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
for (f in c('inputs/res_1vs97.rds','inputs/res_1vs98.rds')) {
  x <- readRDS(f)
  rn <- attr(x, 'rownames')
  ld <- attr(x, 'listData')
  md <- attr(x, 'metadata')
  em <- attr(x, 'elementMetadata')
  cat('\\nFILE', f, '\\n')
  cat('nrows_attr=', attr(x,'nrows'), ' rownames_len=', length(rn), ' listData_len=', length(ld), '\\n', sep='')
  cat('listData names:', paste(names(ld), collapse=', '), '\\n')
  idx <- match('PA14_35160', rn)
  cat('target index:', idx, '\\n')
  for (nm in names(ld)) {
    v <- ld[[nm]]
    cat(nm, ': type=', typeof(v), ' class=', paste(class(v), collapse='|'), ' length=', length(v), ' target=', if ("'!is.na(idx)) as.character(v[[idx]]) else '"'NA', '\\n', sep='')
  }
  cat('metadata names:', paste(names(md), collapse=', '), '\\n')
  cat('metadata compact:\\n')
  print(utils::str(md, max.level=3))
  cat('elementMetadata attrs/names:\\n')
  cat('attrs:', paste(names(attributes(em)), collapse=', '), '\\n')
  cat('listData names in elementMetadata:', paste(names(attr(em, 'listData')), collapse=', '), '\\n')
}
RS"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
ann <- read.csv('inputs/Pseudomonas_aeruginosa_UCBPP-PA14.csv', check.names=FALSE)
qs <- ann[grepl('rhlI|rhlR|lasI|lasR|pqs|mvfR|pqsR|phz', paste(ann[['Gene Name']], ann[['Product Name']], ann[['Product Synonyms']], sep=' '), ignore.case=TRUE), c('Locus Tag','Gene Name','Product Name')]
print(qs, row.names=FALSE)
# Extract DE rows for rhl/las/pqs/phz genes from each result
for (f in c('inputs/res_1vs97.rds','inputs/res_1vs98.rds')) {
  x <- readRDS(f); rn <- attr(x,'rownames'); ld <- attr(x,'listData')
  df <- data.frame(Locus.Tag=rn, log2FoldChange=ld"'$log2FoldChange, padj=ld$padj, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  m <- merge(qs, df, by='"'Locus.Tag', all.x=TRUE, sort=FALSE)
  cat('\\n', f, '\\n')
  print(m[order(m"'$Locus.Tag),], row.names=FALSE)
}
RS'

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
ann <- read.csv('inputs/Pseudomonas_aeruginosa_UCBPP-PA14.csv', check.names=FALSE)
qs <- ann[grepl('rhlI|rhlR|lasI|lasR|pqs|mvfR|pqsR|phz', paste(ann[['Gene Name']], ann[['Product Name']], ann[['Product Synonyms']], sep=' '), ignore.case=TRUE), c('Locus Tag','Gene Name','Product Name')]

for (f in c('inputs/res_1vs97.rds','inputs/res_1vs98.rds')) {
